title: The Kingfisher Clock Rehearsal
description: At first frost, the river-town clockmakers wait for a kingfisher to land on the brass hand. Only then can the winter clock begin.
alt: A blue-and-orange kingfisher approaches the brass hand of a frost-covered clock while two clockmakers watch from a scaffold above the river.
pairing: A river town’s first-frost holiday × kingfishers setting a clock
